theme: one music family: low bowed cello and string drone, sparse felt piano, a slow soft heartbeat pulse
instrumental, sits quietly under a speaking voice

sections.name: This does
styles: MUS-TURN: the release, audible from the very first second
the drone lifts into the first warm chord
a slow cello line moves over moving piano chords
the pulse opens into gentle movement
a new key arrives
clearly audible and moving the whole time, never a single held tone
full and present, the loudest part

sections.name: Proof
styles: MUS-AFTER: warm and hopeful
lifted, strings and piano moving forward
dignified, never jingly
full and present, the loudest part
carries straight on from the section before with no pause, never stops or goes silent

sections.name: Move the load
styles: MUS-OFFER: confident steady pulse
a little fuller and more forward
full and present, the loudest part
carries straight on from the section before with no pause, never stops or goes silent

sections.name: The offer — go and do your stairs
styles: MUS-OFFER: confident, steady and resolved
the same steady pulse and warm strings
plays at a steady level right to the very end of the track
carries straight on with no pause, never stops or goes silent, no ending before the last second
